yoloEnabledTitle: YOLO is enabled: bypasses config policy (hard-deny still applies)
yoloEnabledTitleWithExpiry: YOLO is enabled: bypasses config policy (hard-deny still applies), turns off automatically in about {{minutes}} min
autoEnabledTitle: Auto is enabled: automatically allows uncategorized actions (config's deny rules still apply)
autoToggleTitle: Auto: automatically allows uncategorized middle-ground actions, still bound by config's deny rules and hard-deny
yoloToggleTitle: YOLO: bypasses all of config's rules, turns off automatically after 30 minutes; hard-deny is never affected
risk1: Bypasses every policy rule set in config (including your own custom deny rules).
risk2: Turns off automatically after 30 minutes, returning to normal confirmation mode.
risk3Rest: — writes outside the worktree, reads of secret paths, force-push, and similar actions are still denied or require a forced confirmation.
